title: BITCOIN UPDATE: THIS CHANGES EVERYTHING (for now)!!! - Bitcoin News Today, Ethereum & Altcoins
speaker: Josh (Crypto World)

macro_themes.theme: US stocks pulling back from all-time high
macro_themes.view: Slight premarket weakness after the Nasdaq-100 record high is a short-term negative for crypto, though the stock trend remains bullish.
Bitcoin dominance has been in a sideways range for a year, so major altcoins simply follow Bitcoin's moves.

calls.condition: If BTC breaks and fails to reclaim ~82K, a double top confirms and the pullback likely extends 1-2 weeks; otherwise expect the 82-88K range to hold for another week or so.
calls.reason: Another rejection at 86-88K resistance with an active daily bearish divergence and downside liquidity at ~82K; weekly supertrend green and weekly bullish divergence keep the long-term trend bullish.
calls.quote: we're now obviously moving back down towards the downside liquidity at roughly 82,000. So that is a key target to watch out for.

calls.reason: Slight pullback from a fresh all-time high in premarket; overall trend still bullish.
